description: This file is the main FastAPI app module for the media subtitle synchronization backend. It defines API endpoints for health check, file upload, status querying, subtitle retrieval, file listing, and WebSocket info. It initializes app configuration, database connection, and performs server setup tasks such as middleware and static file serving.

classes.name: MediaFile
classes.description: Database model representing uploaded media files and their processing states.

classes.name: ProcessingStatusEnum
classes.description: Enumeration for processing statuses such as PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, ERROR.

classes.name: UploadResponse
classes.description: Response schema for upload endpoint, containing the assigned media id and status.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Response schema for status query, reporting current progress, errors, and timestamps.

classes.name: FileItem
classes.description: Representation of each media file in list responses.

classes.name: FilesListResponse
classes.description: Wrapper schema for list of media files and count.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health status endpoint returning a simple 'Healthy' message.

methods.name: upload_media( background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Audio/Video media file to upload for subtitle synchronization."), theme: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Theme preference for docs UI hint (dark|light)."), x_theme: Optional[str] = Header(None, convert_underscores=False, description="Theme preference header (dark|light)."), )
methods.description: Receives media file upload. Saves file, creates DB record, triggers processing, and returns status.

methods.name: get_status( id: str = Query(..., description="The id returned by the upload endpoint."), theme: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Theme preference for docs UI hint (dark|light)."), x_theme: Optional[str] = Header(None, convert_underscores=False, description="Theme preference header (dark|light)."), )
methods.description: Returns the processing status of a specific media by its ID.

methods.name: get_subtitles( id: str = Query(..., description="The id returned by the upload endpoint."), download: bool = Query(False, description="Set true to download the subtitle file."), )
methods.description: Serves the generated subtitles either inline or as a downloadable file.

methods.name: list_files()
methods.description: Lists all uploaded media files with their statuses and timestamps.

methods.name: websocket_usage_help()
methods.description: Provides forward-looking info about websocket-based real-time updates (not yet implemented).
